newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM calls for closer economic ties with Asia.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM calls for closer economic ties with Asia.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on Thursday urged new Trade Minister Shinji Sato to promote further economic and industrial cooperation with other Asian countries, Sato told a news conference.
Following his appointment as head of the Ministry of International Trade and Industry, Sato said he was also asked by Hashimoto to use new ideas in trying to reform Japan's economic structures.
"The prime minister asked me to promote further economic and industrial ties not only with the United States and European nations but with Japan's Asian neighbours," he said.
